title: An Old Friend Calls
sentences: My friend Anna called me on Sunday evening.
We were at school together many years ago.
We had not spoken for almost three years.
At first I did not know what to say.
After a few minutes it felt easy again.
She has two children now and lives near the sea.
She asked me about my job and my family.
We talked for more than an hour.
She wants me to visit her in the summer.
I think I will go in July.
